verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official server-side SDK, `@airwallex/node-sdk`, a TypeScript-first package for its platform APIs. The docs list strongly typed request/response models, built-in error handling, automatic retries, token refresh and support for custom requests, so the core of the story is delivered. missing for 10: the SDKs are labeled beta (not GA), only one language (Node.js/TypeScript) is evidenced, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
